phrases.speak: Unlock five powerful Windows tools with one shortcut. Hold the Windows key, and press R.
phrases.show: Unlock five powerful Windows tools with one shortcut. Hold the Windows key and press R.

phrases.speak: Number forty-one. Task Schedule dot M S C opens Task Scheduler. See which automated tasks run, when they start, and what actions they perform. Great for spotting what launches at startup.
phrases.show: Number 41. taskschd.msc opens Task Scheduler. See which automated tasks run, when they start, and what actions they perform. Great for spotting what launches at startup.

phrases.speak: Number forty-two. S H R P U W opens the Shared Folder Wizard, helping you configure network folder sharing and control who can access your files.
phrases.show: Number 42. shrpubw opens the Shared Folder Wizard, helping you configure network folder sharing and control who can access your files.

phrases.speak: Number forty-three. System Properties Remote opens remote access settings. Review Remote Assistance and, on supported editions, Remote Desktop options, without changing your security configuration.
phrases.show: Number 43. SystemPropertiesRemote opens remote access settings. Review Remote Assistance and, on supported editions, Remote Desktop options, without changing your security configuration.

phrases.speak: Number forty-four. This command opens Sign-in options. Review your PIN, Windows Hello, fingerprint and facial recognition settings, depending on your device.
phrases.show: Number 44. This command opens Sign-in options. Review your PIN, Windows Hello, fingerprint and facial recognition settings, depending on your device.

phrases.speak: Number forty-five. This command opens Windows Update History. Check installed security patches, update names and installation dates when troubleshooting your computer.
phrases.show: Number 45. This command opens Windows Update History. Check installed security patches, update names and installation dates when troubleshooting your computer.

phrases.speak: Five powerful tools. One keyboard shortcut. Save these commands, and follow Agentoon dot A I for more Windows tips.
phrases.show: Five powerful tools. One keyboard shortcut. Save these commands and follow Agentoon.ai for more Windows tips.
